title: Instance statement, org-instance/1 (DEC-0170)
description: The organization server's signed statement that one instance runs for one organization: its id, product, origin, placement, status and revision, for at most 7 days. A signing key of the organization's org-key-set/1 signs it over the RFC 8785 form of the document without sig (the register's org-instance/1, DEC-0063). The platform (instance_put, PLAT-146) and the instance's product verify it offline. It names no person.

issuer.description: The organization server's https:// origin in lower case, as the organization's key set and the estate's pin name it.

instanceId.description: The instance's opaque id, as the platform's record and the instance's product name it (DEC-0170 IS-1).

product.description: The product the instance runs, the platform's opaque product key.

origin.description: The instance's https:// origin in lower case, compared as written.

placement.description: Where the instance runs: the organization's cloud, a member's or the organization's machine, or a PassionCode service.

status.description: active, or retired: the issuer states a retirement with a higher revision rather than going silent; a reader stops serving or accepting a retired instance.

revision.description: Rises with every statement for this (org, instanceId); a reader refuses a lower one and the same one with other bytes.

expiresAt.description: After notBefore and at most 7 days after issuedAt (FAC-SEM-177); no grace.

alg.description: Ed25519 only; ES256 may join additively by a later decision.

kid.description: The signing key's kid, as the organization's current org-key-set/1 lists it (the platform's request, PLAT-146).

sig.description: The Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, base64url without padding) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the document without sig.
